title: Contoso Azure – Solution Architecture
summary: Contoso runs a hub-and-spoke Azure landing zone in West Europe. A connectivity hub with Azure Firewall, VPN and ExpressRoute gateways connects head office to a clinical data platform spoke and a trial applications spoke. A separate sandbox subscription is used for analytics experiments.

workloads.name: Connectivity hub
workloads.summary: Azure Firewall, VPN + ExpressRoute gateways, Bastion and DNS resolver
workloads.description: All traffic between on-premises and the spokes passes through the hub. Head office connects by site-to-site VPN and ExpressRoute; spoke traffic is forced through Azure Firewall with user-defined routes.

workloads.name: Clinical data platform
workloads.summary: Data Factory, Databricks, SQL Managed Instance and SAS grid
workloads.description: Data lands in stclinicallandingprod through Data Factory, is processed in Databricks and SQL Managed Instance, and is analysed on the SAS grid VMs. Storage and Key Vault are reached through private endpoints.

workloads.name: Trial applications
workloads.summary: Web apps behind Application Gateway WAF and Front Door
workloads.description: Patient and site-facing applications run on App Service behind Application Gateway (WAF) and Azure Front Door, with Azure SQL, a FHIR service and an AKS cluster for randomisation.

workloads.name: Operations & monitoring
workloads.summary: Log Analytics, Automation, Backup and Purview

story: Head office connects to the hub over site-to-site VPN (cn-vpn-hq-london) and ExpressRoute (cn-er-equinix).
Spoke VNets are peered to the hub and send traffic through Azure Firewall (afw-hub-weu) using route tables.
Clinical data is ingested by Data Factory, processed in Databricks and SQL Managed Instance, and analysed on the SAS grid.
Trial applications are published through Front Door and Application Gateway WAF; back ends are private.
Logs go to the central Log Analytics workspace and VMs are protected by Azure Backup.

cards.name: Clinical data platform
cards.summary: Ingest, process and analyse study data

keyFacts: Hub-and-spoke network in West Europe with all spoke traffic inspected by Azure Firewall.
Data services are reached through private endpoints.
The analytics sandbox is isolated from production.

declaredFlows.name: Study data ingestion
declaredFlows.note: Study data lands in stclinicallandingprod, Data Factory copies it to the data lake and Databricks processes it (declared flow: Azure Resource Graph cannot see data movement).

notes: Scope: the connectivity hub and the clinical data platform spoke. Trial applications and the sandbox are excluded.
